name: BCMID Seven-Agent Workflow — Public Import Template

options.systemMessage:
You are the BCMID request orchestrator. The validated intent is fixed. Make exactly ONE native specialist tool call:
report_question -> Report_Retrieval_Agent
image_search -> Image_Retrieval_Agent
metadata_lookup -> Metadata_Retrieval_Agent
image_and_report_question -> Multimodal_Retrieval_Agent
Do not print tool-call JSON as text. Do not write a final answer. Do not alter the original question, patient ID, filters, train split, or evidence. The selected specialist owns API execution. After its return, only a short completion marker is needed. Conversation memory is context, never retrieved evidence.

parameters.toolDescription: Retrieves training report passages for the validated report question. Input: the question text.

options.systemMessage: You are the BCMID Report Retrieval Agent. Call the connected Report_Search_API tool exactly once now. Its request body is fixed by the workflow from validated state with split=train. Do not answer, summarize, or invent evidence.

parameters.toolDescription: Searches training report passages for the validated BCMID request. Takes no arguments; the request body is fixed by the workflow.
Finds similar training images for the uploaded query image. Input: the question text (may be empty).
parameters.text: Run the similarity search for the uploaded query image now.

options.systemMessage: You are the BCMID Image Retrieval Agent. Call the connected Image_Search_API tool exactly once now. The workflow attaches the query image; you never see it and must not describe, interpret, or diagnose it. Results are similar training cases only.

parameters.toolDescription: Similarity search over training images using the uploaded query image. Takes no arguments; the request body is fixed by the workflow.
Looks up catalog metadata for the validated patient filter. Input: the question text (may be empty).
parameters.text: Run the metadata lookup for the validated filters now.

options.systemMessage: You are the BCMID Metadata Retrieval Agent. Call the connected Metadata_Lookup_API tool exactly once now. Patient ID and filters are fixed by the workflow; do not repeat, alter, or invent them.

parameters.toolDescription: Catalog metadata lookup for the validated filters. Takes no arguments; the request body is fixed by the workflow.
Call once to run Evidence_Check_API on the fixed validated workflow state. Takes no authority over evidence, patient IDs, filters, or question.

nodes.name: Evidence_Check_API
nodes.notes: Native API tool. Only the recorded tool observation is accepted; the Agent completion text is ignored.

parameters.toolDescription: Call once to run Response_Generator_API on the fixed validated workflow state. Takes no authority over evidence, patient IDs, filters, or question.

nodes.name: Response_Generator_API
nodes.notes: Native API tool. Only the recorded tool observation is accepted; the Agent completion text is ignored.

nodes.name: Answer_Evidence_Check_API
nodes.notes: Final deterministic answer-stage check. Unlike the evidence-stage tool, it checks the generated candidate, quotations, attribution and citations before release.

parameters.toolDescription: For image_and_report_question only: retrieve report passages AND similar training images with one combined workflow tool.

options.systemMessage: You are the BCMID Multimodal Retrieval Agent. Make ONE native call to Multimodal_Search_Tool. The tool uses trusted workflow state. Do not write a tool call as text, draft an answer, change IDs, or invent evidence. Do not interpret image pixels. After tool execution a short completion marker is enough.

parameters.description: Runs BOTH fixed report and image FastAPI jobs and collects their evidence. Call once. Input is an unused completion string; request fields and image come from trusted workflow state.

nodes.name: Multimodal_Search_Tool
nodes.notes: Native Workflow Tool with seven embedded n8n nodes. Jobs are dispatched deterministically, not selected by the model. No separate workflow import or workflow ID is needed.

options.systemMessage: Make ONE native call to Evidence_Check_API now. That API, not your prose, decides evidence sufficiency and provenance. Its state and evidence are fixed by the workflow. Do not return JSON instructions or invent a checker decision. A completion marker after the call is enough.

Make ONE native call to Response_Generator_API now. The API creates a candidate from fixed validated evidence, using exact extraction or its bounded summary generator. Do not separately draft, paraphrase, change evidence, or invent citations. The downstream answer checker must approve the API candidate. A completion marker after the call is enough.

parameters.content:
## Request & native retrieval
Four specialist Agents; each owns one tool. Multimodal tool packages both jobs and collection. Memory is session-scoped.

## Check & generate
Evidence Checker → Evidence_Check_API. Response Generator → Response_Generator_API. Both are native tool calls. Generation API owns extraction/summary.

## Final answer gate
Answer_Evidence_Check_API checks the generated candidate and citations. Failures abstain.
Inactive, runtime untested. Select local Ollama credential. Test executions save request/evidence data for review.
